plan.title: Capstone Windows start still uses C:\absolute\path\to\directive-training placeholder

narratives.Description: Capstone Windows start still uses C:\absolute\path\to\directive-training placeholder
narratives.Overview:
## What happened

The capstone lab Windows start block still contains a fake path:

$CourseRoot = (Resolve-Path "C:\absolute\path\to\directive-training").Path

Lab 2 Windows was already changed to read DIRECTIVE_TRAINING_ROOT and fail if unset (after #56). The capstone block will throw Resolve-Path on the placeholder if a learner pastes it without editing.

I completed the capstone on Windows after substituting the real clone path. Node v26.8.1, Task 3.50.0, uv 0.11.14, Python 3.12.10. Helper sequence create through close, then reset and both archives, all passed. Closeout: implemented / local_pass / ship, deployment, and UAT not_started.

## Why this is hard for a human

Same class of trap as closed #56: prose says the path is learner input, the snippet still contains a fake path. A paste-first learner never reaches create.

## Suggested repair

Match Lab 2 Windows: require $env:DIRECTIVE_TRAINING_ROOT (or $CourseRoot) to be set before the block, and do not overwrite it with a placeholder.
